newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Esat says completes $85.4 mln bond offering in US.
newsitem.headline: Esat says completes $85.4 mln bond offering in US.

text.p: Ireland's Esat Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had completed an $85.4 million funding in the U.S. by way of a high yield bond offering which was oversubscribed.

Some of the largest institutional investment houses in the U.S., including Fidelity, Merrill Lynch Asset Management, Prudential, Capital Research and Putnam, participated in the funding, Esat said in a statement.
"Taking into account the confidence shown in our company by U.S. investors, it is likely that we will be returning to the U.S. capital markets in the future," Esat chairman Denis O'Brien said.
A total of 45 institutions participated in the bond offering and Fidelity, Merrill Lynch Asset Management, Prudential, Capital Research and Putnam accounted for 40 percent.

Last year, an equity investment of $45 million in Esat Holdings Ltd attracted a number of U.S. investors including Soros Capital, Metropolitan Life, Credit Suisse First Boston and John Hancock who now hold a 39.49 percent stake in the company between them.
Esat Holdings owns Esat Telecom which started operations three years ago and provides international and inland long distance telecommunications services to corporate customers.
It also holds a 40 percent stake in Esat Digifone, the consortium awarded Ireland's second mobile phone licence in 1995 and which includes Norwegian state telecom company Telenor.

Esat said the bond issue, which was fixed for 10 years at 12.5 percent with no interest payable in the first five years, was at a very attractive rate and compared very favourably with funding raised by other companies in the telecom sectors.
The finance will be used to further invest in switching platforms for Esat Telecom and in its national long distance infrastructure.
It will also be used for the development of new services and for further investment in Esat Digifone.
Its mobile phone service, originally due for launch in the third quarter of 1996, will now launch during the first quarter of this year, the company said.
"Already our 200 Esat Digifone employees are extremely well advanced in the preparation for launch phase," it said.
Esat also announced results for the nine months ended September 30, 1996. The company made a pre-tax loss of 7.51 million punts on revenues of 7.79 million.
Earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortisation were 2.70 million while Esat Digifone's pre-trading costs came to 3.52 million, the company said.
